questions.text: In a ninety-minute session, roughly how much should the leader be talking?
options: Most of it, since they prepared
Well under half, so the group does most of the talking

questions.text: One person answers every question first. What helps most?
options: Inviting someone else by name with an easy question

questions.text: Which is a facilitation habit rather than a lecturing one?
options: Giving the background of the passage at length
Sending a question back to the group: what do others think?
Summarising every answer before moving on
